domain: Enterprise reporting system for financial operations.

glossary.definition: Automated daily summary of processed transactions.
Centralised file store where generated daily reports are retained, organised by report date and accessible to authorised users for a rolling 7-year period.

business_rules.rule: Each generated report must be delivered to the report archive within 5 minutes of generation; if delivery fails, the system must retry every 10 minutes for up to 2 hours before raising an alert to the operations team.
